summary: This directory serves as a dedicated testing environment for internal build logic related to JSDoc update planning. It encapsulates the verification process for the context generation required to perform systematic documentation updates.
responsibilities: Verify the generation of update context plans for JSDoc documentation
Ensure internal build logic for documentation updates functions correctly
Provide an isolated environment for testing JSDoc-specific update workflows
relationships: The update context plan defines the scope and requirements for processing JSDoc updates.
Build logic is exercised within this test suite to validate the integrity of the generated context plans.
designDecisions: Colocation of test suites with internal build logic
Use of specialized environments for internal API verification
